start.title: La llanura de Sinar
start.text:
Una vasta llanura verde se extiende ante ti.
Toda la humanidad se ha reunido aquí — un solo pueblo, una sola lengua.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Settle and build a home
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You sink roots into the earth. It feels right.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Dream of something greater
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 11:2 — The people settled in the plain of Shinar and dreamed of greatness.

unity.title: Una Sola Lengua
unity.text:
Las voces se mezclan. Las risas se elevan.
No hay palabra que no puedas entender.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Praise God for the gift of unity
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You lift your voice in thanks. Others bow their heads.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Boast of what we could achieve
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 11:4 — They said, 'Let us make a name for ourselves.'

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stay silent — listen to the elders
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Wise voices speak softly. Others shout louder.

proposal.title: La Gran Idea
proposal.text:
Un anciano se levanta. «Construyamos una torre — cuya cima llegue a los cielos.»
«Hagamos un nombre para nosotros mismos.»

choices.text: [TODO:es] Cheer — join the great work
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 11:3-4 — The people joined together to build a city and a great tower.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Speak against it — this is pride
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Few hear you. But the words are spoken.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Wait — let others decide
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Silence is its own answer. The vote passes.

bricks.title: Ladrillos y Alquitrán
bricks.text:
Moldeas arcilla húmeda para hacer ladrillos.
Son más fuertes que la piedra. Llegarán al cielo.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Work for the love of craft
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 11:3 — They made bricks and used tar for mortar to build the tower.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Race the others — outshine them
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your speed turns to recklessness. Bricks crack.

construction.title: Los Primeros Pisos
construction.text:
Las paredes se elevan. La torre proyecta una larga sombra.
Los hombres cantan mientras levantan cada viga.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Boast — "We need no God now"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 11:4 — They boasted, seeking a tower with its top reaching the heavens.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Work quietly — say a prayer
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] No one hears. But the prayer is heard above.

rising.title: Más Alto
rising.text:
Año tras año. Piedra sobre piedra.
La torre perfora las nubes.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Doubt — should we stop?
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You whisper it. The wind carries the words away.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Climb higher — there is no limit
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 11:4-5 — The tower rose higher in pride until the Lord came down to see it.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Demand the workers go faster
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Tempers fray. Hands bleed. The tower climbs.

summit.title: Tocando el Cielo
summit.text:
Estás en la cima. La tierra es pequeña abajo.
Los cielos se sienten cerca — casi al alcance.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Reach upward — claim the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 11:4 — Their pride reached upward, seeking to make a name for themselves.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Kneel — feel suddenly small
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The vastness above swallows your pride.

gods_gaze.title: Él Desciende
gods_gaze.text:
Una voz llena el aire, tranquila como un trueno.
«Son un solo pueblo. Nada les será imposible.»

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stand defiant before the voice
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 11:6-7 — God saw their pride and chose to confuse their language.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bow your head in fear and awe
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your knees buckle. The presence is everywhere.

confusion.title: Palabras Extrañas
confusion.text:
Le gritas a tu amigo. Él te mira fijamente.
Su boca se abre — pero los sonidos no tienen sentido.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Force him to understand — shout louder
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Anger only deepens the void between you.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Step back — accept what God has done
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 11:7 — God confused their language so they could not understand one another.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Blame the elders — start a fight
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Fists fly. The tower bleeds men instead of mortar.

scattering.title: Partiendo
scattering.text:
Las familias recogen lo que pueden.
Cada grupo camina hacia un horizonte diferente.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Curse the heavens as you leave
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Bitterness is a heavy load to carry.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk in silence, lesson in heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 11:8 — The Lord scattered the people from there over all the earth.

reflection.title: Una Nueva Tierra
reflection.text:
Te detienes en una cresta tranquila.
La torre queda muy atrás — un recuerdo de orgullo.
